title: Imperatives
summary: Use the imperative for commands, instructions, warnings and directions.

explanation.en: The imperative uses the base form of the verb. Use don't before the verb for a negative command.
explanation.ru: Повелительное наклонение использует начальную форму глагола. Для отрицательной команды ставится don't перед глаголом.

examples.en: Turn left at the traffic lights.

commonMistakes.note: For a direct instruction, the subject is normally omitted.
Use the base verb after don't.
